provenance.widthSource: width_ft multiplied by 0.3048; aerial-derived source values, not a new field survey
provenance.renderGeometry: Source-width buffers unioned and clipped; original map/road/building data are unchanged.
provenance.precisionPolicy: Derived topology uses a 1 mm grid; final shared ramp/slab intersection vertices retain their exact serialized coordinates to prevent overlapping tops.
provenance.curbs: Source strip side boundaries only; no crossing/driveway endpoint caps, ramp openings or artificial cut edges.
provenance.crossings: Source crossing lines are walking guides and qualify ramp endpoints; no painted markings are generated.

existingGradeSeparatedPaths.disposition: Source snapshot and walking guide retained; excluded only from new raised slabs because existing Dequindre Cut renderer/support preserves its grade-separated route.

limitations: Source features were digitized in 2019 and have 2020 secondary edit fields; service edit time is not a photo date.
No surveyed curb heights, crossfalls, ramp designs, driveway inventory, or grade-separated crossing elevations are supplied.
Derived ramps are authored game geometry and are not accessibility certification.
